name: When should I consider hiring a workers' comp claims lawyer?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider hiring a workers' comp claims lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider hiring a workers' comp claims lawyer if your claim has been denied, if you're experiencing delays in receiving benefits, or if the insurance company disputes the extent of your injuries. A lawyer can also be beneficial if your employer retaliates against you for filing a claim, if you have a pre-existing condition that complicates your case, or if you're offered a settlement that seems too low. Legal representation ensures your rights are protected and you receive fair compensation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider hiring a lawyer if your claim is denied, delayed, or if the insurance company disputes your injuries. A lawyer protects your rights and helps secure fair compensation.
